_comment: The matrix npm run warm fetches. Stage 3 folds the destination half of this into destinations.json; the windows stay here because they are a property of the warm run, not of a place. airport null means the trip is a drive, so no flight search is made for it — that is where most of the quota saving lives.

destinations.name: Zion National Park
destinations.note: 430 miles. No scheduled service gets you there and back in a weekend.

destinations.name: Joshua Tree
destinations.note: A drive. The nearest airport is Palm Springs and it costs more than the petrol.

destinations.name: San Diego
destinations.note: Drive or the Pacific Surfliner. Flying LAX-SAN is slower door to door.

destinations.name: San Francisco
destinations.note: The one real flight in the set, which is what makes the car-versus-fly comparison worth showing.
